```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

## Visualizing access antibiotic data from UKHSA dashboard
```{r}
antibiotics <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(antibiotics))
```

```{r}
ggplot (antibiotics, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("DID (Standardised Consumption") +
  ggtitle("Access Antibiotics") +
  ylim (0, 20)
```
